cards.title: Why TypeScript
cards.content:
TypeScript adds static typing to JavaScript, helping catch errors at compile time.

let name: string = "Angular";
let age: number = 17;
let isActive: boolean = true;

cards.title: Interfaces & Enums
cards.content:
Interfaces define the shape of objects. Enums define a set of named constants.

interface User {
  id: number;
  name: string;
}

enum Role {
  Admin,
  User
}

cards.title: Generics & Union Types
cards.content:
Union types allow a variable to hold multiple types. Generics allow creating reusable components that work with multiple types.

let id: string | number;

function wrap<T>(value: T): T[] {
  return [value];
}

content.prompt: To allow a variable to be either a string or a number, use a ___ type.

correctOrder: Declare a variable with a union type
If type is string, use string methods safely
If type is number, use number methods safely
